claims: The primary producers of the 2025 film One Battle After Another are Paul Thomas Anderson, Sara Murphy, and the late Adam Somner.
One Battle After Another is directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
One Battle After Another has nominations from the Producers Guild of America.
One Battle After Another has wins at the BAFTAs.
One Battle After Another serves as a tribute to Adam Somner's work.
Sky News notes that Sara Murphy has highlighted the film's themes of resistance and immigration.
Facebook says the production company for One Battle After Another is Warner Bros. Pictures.
WB Awards say One Battle After Another features an ensemble cast led by Leonardo DiCaprio
